story.blurb: Hiding in a bar after his crew crashes their ship into a mall, Zach is approached by Jack Madison, a cheerful smuggler's driver who will not take silence for an answer.

lines.text: Some mall complex, currently under repairs due to an unknown ship flying into it.

lines.text: Seth is currently trying to charm the authorities with an annoyed Zion behind him. The rest of the crew is nonchalant about it, since this is a common occurrence. Zach has a headache, like borderline migraine. He storms off, leaving a worried Bellow with an amused Dutch, who is watching the conversation with the authorities unfold.

Zach is annoyed, very annoyed. This is supposed to be a professional crew? How the hell can they be “professional” when they crash into a goddamn mall and then act like nothing happened?! At least Zion is acting appropriately… Zach needs to sit down…
He finds some bar eventually, he takes a seat without a word, the bartender doesn’t acknowledge him, since Zach never wanted their attention.

lines.text: Suddenly a presence appears right next to Zach without warning. He turns his head towards the figure and sees how they smile at the bartender, and then order a drink. Zach gets a good look at them.

A human man, who seems taller, has a blonde crewcut, slightly tan skin, and blue eyes. A white undershirt underneath a red and black letterman jacket paired with light-washed blue jeans and well-worn sneakers. His belt is also home to a laser pistol in its holster. He notices that Zach is staring at him, so he smiles back. Zach is taken aback at that. Just who was this guy… he seems… interesting.
